title: OmniVia Chat Runtime Contract v1 - Attachment and Context Reference revalidation
description: Closes CGAP-042-010. Normative wire shapes for the Attachment and Context Reference revalidation result used before an amendment commit (REF-042 §14.2-§14.4, ADR-022 §4.9). Revalidation SHALL check Workspace, actor permission, existence and retention state, source revision where required, security and malware state, target compatibility and size or content policy (REF-042 §14.2). A reference valid on the source Message is not automatically valid for the amended Message; current authority is checked at commit (REF042-RULE-018, ADR022-INV-013). The commit command returns structured reference failures rather than silently omitting a reference that was part of the source Message (REF-042 §14.3).

ReferenceKind.title: ReferenceKind
ReferenceKind.description: The closed v1 reference-kind vocabulary distinguishing an Attachment Reference from a Context Reference for revalidation purposes.

ReferenceRevalidation.title: ReferenceRevalidation
ReferenceRevalidation.description: The outcome of revalidating one Attachment or Context Reference before an amendment commit (REF-042 §14.2). Closes CGAP-042-010. `failure` is present if and only if `outcome` is `invalid`.

sourceRevision.description: Present only when `outcome` is `valid` and a source revision was pinned (REF-042 §14.4).

ReferenceRevalidationBatch.title: ReferenceRevalidationBatch
ReferenceRevalidationBatch.description: The complete revalidation result set produced for one amendment commit attempt (REF-042 §14.2-§14.3), bounded to the reference counts of the source Message.
